content.user_title: Review Java Code for DDD Compliance
content.value_statement: Java teams need a consistent way to find DDD architecture violations before they spread. This skill checks the requested change set or full project against DDD layer and dependency rules.
actual_capabilities: Select incremental review for change-focused requests and full review for project-wide requests.
Identify changed Java files with local Git diff commands in incremental mode.
Discover non-test Java files for a full architecture audit.
Check package placement, base classes, naming, dependencies, and structural rules.
Review cross-layer dependency direction and common DDD anti-patterns.
Report violations with severity, affected files, and recommended fixes.
limitations: It is designed for Java projects that follow the referenced DDD layer conventions.
It reviews source structure and documented rules; it does not compile, run, or test the project.
It cannot confirm whether an apparent violation is an approved architectural exception without project context.
Incremental mode is limited to files identified by the local Git diff.

use_cases.title: Pre-commit change review
use_cases.description: Check staged Java changes for DDD violations before creating a commit.

use_cases.title: Architecture health audit
use_cases.description: Review an entire Java codebase for layer boundaries and dependency direction.

use_cases.title: Release readiness check
use_cases.description: Produce a prioritized DDD compliance review before a release.

prompt_templates.title: Check my changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my staged Java changes for DDD compliance.

prompt_templates.title: Review a package
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the changed Java files in the order package for DDD layer and dependency violations.

prompt_templates.title: Audit the project
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a full DDD compliance audit of this Java project and prioritize the most serious violations.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare release report
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a pre-release DDD audit. Include layer findings, cross-layer dependencies, anti-patterns, and ranked fixes.

output_examples.input: Check my staged Java changes for DDD compliance.
output: Incremental review completed for changed Java files.
Medium: an application service imports an infrastructure repository.
Fix: depend on the domain repository interface instead.

output_examples.input: Run a full DDD compliance audit.
output: Executive summary: dependency direction needs attention.
High: domain code depends on an infrastructure package.
Recommendation: move the dependency behind a domain interface.

best_practices: Use incremental mode before each commit to keep architectural issues small.
Provide project-specific layer conventions when they differ from the documented rules.
Review high-severity findings with the code owner before changing intentional exceptions.
anti_patterns: Do not treat successful compilation as proof of architecture compliance.
Do not use incremental results as a substitute for periodic full-project audits.
Do not apply suggested fixes without checking the affected layer contracts.

faq.question: What projects does this skill support?
faq.answer: It is intended for Java projects that use domain-driven design layers and conventions.

faq.question: How does the skill choose a review mode?
faq.answer: It uses the request wording to select incremental review or a full project audit.

faq.question: What does incremental mode inspect?
faq.answer: It inspects Java files identified by local Git diff output.

faq.question: Does the skill modify my code?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow reviews files and reports violations with suggested fixes.

faq.question: Does the skill run builds or tests?
faq.answer: No. It performs a structural architecture review and does not compile or test the project.

faq.question: Can I use it for a release review?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for a full or pre-release audit to receive a prioritized compliance report.
